description: AULA F75 Max host layer. The board's own firmware maps F1/F3/F5-F12 to the collision-free tokens F13-F15 and F18-F24. F16/F17 stay unbound because the CIDOO runtime owns them globally. Space, CapsLock and every other key are left stock.

F13.note: Undo on tap, redo on hold. SolidWorks and Excel never adopted Ctrl+Shift+Z, so they get Ctrl+Y.

F14.note: Focus-or-launch the two most-switched-to non-CAD apps: Chrome 16.2 percent of focus events, Outlook 5.8 percent.

focusApp.note: Outlook classic. New Outlook (olk.exe) is also installed but unused.

F15.note: Tap flips to the previous window. Hold opens the switcher and keeps it open: each further press of the key advances one window, releasing commits.

F18.note: SolidWorks is 19.1 percent of all app switches, the single biggest target. Explorer on hold: activate an existing browser window, else open a new one.

focusApp.note: explorer.exe always runs as the shell, so the window class is what distinguishes a real file browser window from the desktop and taskbar.

F19.note: Current live-tool pair. Tap focuses or launches Claude; hold focuses or launches the Remote Desktop client.

F20.note: Media keys sit on F20/F23 because the telemetry cannot see them: they never reach an app, so there is no evidence they earn a better key.

F21.note: Sticky num layer toggle. Tap-only, so it fires on key-down with zero delay.

F22.note: Paste 778 times and copy 443 times in 13 days, the two highest-count chords measured. Tap gets the more frequent one.

F23.note: See F20 on why media landed here.

F24.note: Save on tap, Save As on hold.

num.note: Right-hand numeric pad. Toggled by F21, stays on until toggled off. Space is deliberately absent: it stays a plain Space.
